content:
The agreement covers the full suite of AI training courses from Europe's leading provider of AI professional training

Today Magnetiz.ai, the AI Consulting practice of Revwisely, announces an agreement that brings Europe's leading AI training to US customers. Developed by Danish company 33A, Magnetiz.ai will license 33A's Bootcamp AI Design Sprint™ training for individuals, companies, and organizations.

"Individuals and teams are asking for help bringing AI into their organizations," said Chris Preston, CEO of Revwisely. "This partnership gives our customers powerful new tools, content, and processes to prepare the modern workplace for AI."

Modeled after the Google Design Sprint, the Bootcamp AI Design Sprint is a hands-on experience where participants learn as a team to improve a process by applying AI. The interactive training, supported by creative visual tools, is for business and technical stakeholders. Upon completing the course, participants become certified AI Design Sprint™ Facilitators. Participants can perform an AI assessment, start AI projects, and guide a team through the tech check.

"We're delivering AI training to participants across Europe, plus South Africa, China, Japan, and Singapore, so adding the US is a natural step," said Mike Brandt, 33A Co-founder and CEO. "We're thrilled to have a trusted, capable partner like Magnetiz.ai who shares our vision for making AI more accessible for everyone."

The family of Bootcamp AI Design Sprint training consists of Bootcamp AI Design Sprint™: Process Automation and Bootcamp AI Design Sprint™: Products & Services. Upcoming courses include specialized tracks for generative AI, healthcare, and sustainability. Courses are typically 20 hours long and spread over five days. Prices start at $1,399 per course.

About Magnetiz.ai

Magnetiz.ai is the AI Consulting practice of Revwisely. The practice specializes in helping individuals and teams bring AI into their organizations. The company's mission is to make AI more accessible for everyone. It does this by empowering employees and helping employers grow revenue, lower costs, and improve efficiency. Learn more at https://www.magnetiz.ai and https://www.revwisely.com.

About 33A

33A is an AI implementation design firm based in Copenhagen, Denmark. The company is known for creatively integrating AI with Design Thinking and Service Systems Design. The 33A AI Design Sprint™ enables anyone and any team to develop holistic AI solutions by bridging the gap between non-technical business people and AI experts. Learn more at https://www.33a.ai/.
